name: Superbounce double jump: a double jump right after the superbounce keeps half its speed
techNote: A floor and a tall wall (face at x 380) with the finish box high up its face (x 280-370, y 600-700). Jump right from x 230, and on input 6 dash right flat with jump on dash frame 1 (released with the dash press): the dash reaches the wall on its 3rd frame, inside the dash boost window (dashBoostMax 6), so the buffered jump is the superbounce (SpecialWallJump(0.6, 1, up*410)): Velocity (-276, 703 after the tick's gravity), momentum.y 400.8. Double jump on input 9, 2 ticks after the bounce: after a jump that wasn't a normal one the air jump only needs Velocity.y < 700, and it keeps half of it: Velocity.y 745 + 649/2 = 1069.5, while the bounce's momentum still pushes up, so the dot climbs about 29 u a tick and is in the box on tick 30 (peak y 779.7). `no-double` (the superbounce alone) peaks at 437.3; `jump-double` (a jump and a double jump 9 ticks later, no dash) at 375.

ghosts.label: A jump and a double jump, no dash
